trello.name: Frontend checkout process
trello.desc: Build the frontend checkout process using Stripe Elements. Ensure the checkout form matches the app's design and handles errors gracefully, such as invalid card details or insufficient funds.

trello.name: Update pricing page
trello.desc: Update the pricing page to reflect the new subscription tiers (Basic $29, Pro $49, Enterprise $99). Include a clean design, a clear comparison of features for each tier, a prominent checkout button, and a tooltip or help icon explaining what happens if a user chooses a different plan later.

trello.name: Build user dashboard
trello.desc: Build a user dashboard that shows current plan details and billing info, provides options to upgrade, downgrade, or cancel subscriptions, gives access to invoices and payment history, and allows updating payment methods. The dashboard must reflect the current subscription status in real-time and notify users of changes like successful upgrades or payment failures.

trello.name: Stripe API backend integration
trello.desc: Integrate Stripe's API on the backend to handle all subscription-related tasks, including creating subscriptions when a user selects a plan and completes payment, and processing successful and failed payments.

trello.name: Set up and test webhook handlers
trello.desc: Set up webhook handlers for invoice.payment_succeeded, invoice.payment_failed, and customer.subscription.deleted. Ensure the system updates correctly, send email notifications for failed payments, and manage access rights for cancellations. Create test scenarios to simulate different events like payment failures and cancellations.

trello.name: Integrate frontend with backend API
trello.desc: Integrate the frontend components with the backend API. Ensure changes to the subscription are reflected in real-time on the dashboard. Handle errors during integration and provide clear notifications to users, such as instructions on how to fix failed payments.

trello.name: Prepare and share test plan
trello.desc: Prepare a detailed test plan covering manual and automated tests for the whole subscription flow (from sign-up to billing to managing the subscription) and share it with Alex and Jordan.

trello.name: Create user documentation and FAQ
trello.desc: Create a help section or FAQ that covers common issues and questions about subscriptions to provide clear instructions for users once everything is live.

trello.name: Document API endpoints and webhook handlers
trello.desc: Document the API endpoints and webhook event handlers to make maintenance and troubleshooting easier in the future.

trello.name: Schedule follow-up meeting
trello.desc: Set up a follow-up meeting for next week to review progress on the Stripe integration, address any issues, and discuss blockers.
